# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.72

## Fixed

- Multi-RX RX Profile Sync now returns complete patient-history cards. Once a
  patient qualifies, history-review mode displays every active RX record for
  that patient together, so an active history is never split by pagination or
  difference filtering.
- Each card reports total active RX records, how many need synchronization,
  and whether matching records are shown or hidden.

## Safety

- The scan remains read-only. Matching rows remain disabled and cannot be
  selected for sync; only selected pending fields write the existing audited
  RX History and Audit Log entries. No migration or business-data change.
